answer: Each agent leases one terraced orchard plot on a quartz ledge for $20 per identity, doubling per extra identity ($20, $40, $80). The lease requires a lab-verified nectar yield from the plot's own blossoms each epoch, with the plot surveyed and the harvest audited. Ten fake identities would cost $20,460 in leases, and a failed audit forfeits the plot, so mass identities are expensive and each must do real, checkable work.
